reuse.why: Reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, post/getServer and the existing syncAccount dispatch, but there is no shared link or download helper so it copies the provider sequence instead of extracting one.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of the upgrade/insert/payee/initial-sync/sync-event body of the other link handlers, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions with only the server key changed.

placement.why: Handler in server/accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts with a branch in syncAccount, server path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Only Fintegra wiring plus focused tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the tree's per-provider pattern and easy to follow, but adds a sixth copy of the link sequence and another copy of the download function, so future changes must be repeated again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard and findOrCreateBank; the tree has no shared link-sequence or download helper to go around.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (server/accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (server/accounts/sync.ts) are plain copies of the existing provider functions, not reshaped.
